summary:
## Restore Playgrounds + Split App From Playground

### Phase 0 — Unblocked all playgrounds
- Fixed CSS import (`ui.css`), CAD vite config, `PUZZLE_PLAY_ENTRY` registry gating, sketchpad MDX stubs, build-script wasm safety

### Phase 1 — CAD migration
- `@semio-tech/cad-js-renderer-core` + react package; registered as 24th playground; deleted `cad/js/renderer/play/`

### Phase 2 — App/playground split (24 technologies)
`core/index.ts` = app; `core/playground.ts` = fixtures + dev-host + `*PlayAppDefinition`

### Phase 3 — Verification
- All 24 `bun ./script.ts build --app <entry>` succeed
- Post-split fixes: forms circular export, procedural-2d re-exports, presentation.deck program, s fixture globs, cad test updates
- Remaining test debt: 4 cad document integration tests, s-core controller tests (pre-existing)
